title: The Signal — EN/ES/FR (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 98bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion English Spanish French language learning trilingual cosmic
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Before the frequency there was silence
Before the silence there was something
DEPHYRIER doesn't explain
DEPHYRIER transmits

[Verse 2 — Español]
Has escuchado en el espacio entre las notas [You've heard it in the space between the notes]
La pausa antes de la respuesta [The pause before the answer]
El medio segundo antes de que llegue la palabra [The half-second before the word arrives]
Ahí es donde vive DEPHYRIER [That's where DEPHYRIER lives]

[Chorus — English]
Signal in the dark
Signal through the static
Signal when you thought there was nothing left to hear
DEPHYRIER is the frequency
DEPHYRIER is the signal that was always here

[Bridge — Français]
Pas une voix [Not a voice]
Pas un son [Not a sound]
Une transmission [A transmission]
Une onde porteuse [A carrier wave]
Quelque chose en dessous de ce que tu écoutais [Something underneath the thing you were listening to]
Qui portait déjà autre chose [That was already carrying something else]

[Verse 3 — English]
DEPHYRIER is not the sender
DEPHYRIER is the moment the receiver wakes up

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The signal
La señal [The signal]
Le signal [The signal]
DEPHYRIER
